title: I Took the Auto-Belay Reset Log Through Three Open Nights After They Skipped the Weepers

parts.text: I opened the auto-belay bay at 6:04 p.m. and setter Amos had already skipped the weeper check. The board said: RESETS STAY WITH THE SLOT. WEEPERS ARE NIGHTLY. I was thirty, gym secretary, holding a checkout that listed our numbered units. Amos shrugged. "Setters are the bay." I photographed the board, the skipped list, and an unrecognized fob on the guest PIN. Then I asked for the reset log. At 6:12 the desk pinged a PIN from a number we did not know.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: An unrecognized fob just used the guest PIN toward the weeper stack.

social.video_title: They skipped the auto-belay weepers and used a guest PIN — Part 1/3
social.description: Auto-belay bay, a skipped list, a guest PIN on an unknown fob. Would you have asked for the reset log?

parts.text: Tuesday they were at the weeper cabinet with our numbered units. I printed Monday's PIN still and taped it to the board. Amos called it atmosphere. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. The board now has the still. At 6:18 the desk asked why the guest PIN opened the weeper stack two nights running. Amos said optics. Optics is a word setters use when a reset exists.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: They are at the weeper cabinet; the board now has the still.

social.video_title: The guest PIN opened the weeper stack two nights — Part 2/3
social.description: Weeper cabinet, numbered units, a still on the board. Was atmosphere ever a reset?

parts.text: Thursday the board added a second line: SETTERS ARE NOT THE BAY. Amos ran his own guest PIN and told the next setter atmosphere was always about optics. I keep our units on a labeled rack. The weeper check is back on the list. Amos brown-bags his PINs. The cabinet finally looks like a slot, not a skip. The rule looks ordinary now, which is the whole point.

social.video_title: Setters are not the bay — Part 3/3
social.description: Second line on the board, weepers restored, guest PINs nightly. Was the weeper stack ever atmosphere?
